text:
maria: CI red on main after merge of PR #4567 — smoke + e2e failing. Link: https://ci.internal/reports/7312345678 Anyone can grab please?

ci-bot: Pipeline failed: main-build -> smoke-gpu (step: smoke-gpu-run) exited 1. Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/7312345678/smoke-gpu

sam: @maria on it. what's the failing test? paste a snippet?

maria: here's the failing tail:

```
E 02:12:34 smoke_test.py::test_kv_alloc - AssertionError: expected free_slots > 0, got 0
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "smoke_test.py", line 120, in test_kv_alloc
    self.assertGreater(kv.free_slots(), 0)
AssertionError: 0 not greater than 0
```

ryan: sounds like kv allocation regression. Any recent allocator-related merges in that PR? @priya

maria: PR #4567 touched scheduler prefetch; didn't touch allocator directly but changed batch sizing: https://git.internal/repo/pull/4567

priya: I can grep commit history for kvalloc changes. Also fyi I saw similar flake yesterday but auto-passed on rerun.

sam: before bisect can we rerun smoke-gpu with same seed? command: ./ci/rerun.sh --job smoke-gpu --build 7312345678 --seed 20260315

oncall: grabbing. Marking as first-responder. I'll kick a rerun and try a quick bisect if it fails again.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: job smoke-gpu (build 7312345720). Status will post update.

sam: if rerun fails, I can start a git bisect using this range: origin/main~20..origin/main and test locally with smoke harness. Heads-up might need a smaller reproducer: use smoke_test.py::test_kv_alloc -kvcache=true

maria: commit sha that merged: 5f2a9b1 (from PR 4567). Old passing commit (known-good): 3c8d7e4

ryan: suggestion: run with small change to kv cache size env to see if it's cache pressure: KV_CACHE_MAX=32 ./ci/local_run.sh smoke_test.py::test_kv_alloc

sam: ran the rerun, still failing on 5f2a9b1 — looks deterministic locally on that commit. Bisect started, first bad is somewhere between 3c8d7e4..5f2a9b1. I'll post progress.

oncall: creating a short revert PR for 5f2a9b1 as a precaution: https://git.internal/repo/pull/4570 (draft). Hold merge until bisect shows exact culprit.

maria: prefer hold on revert unless we confirm invariant regression — can we try canary by pinning model shard count and rerun smoke? if passes then likely scheduling change.

priya: doing a quick grep now, will ping findings.

sam: bisect narrowed down to commit 4b6f11a -> introduces change in batch/tracker. Opening a small PR to revert that specific part.

oncall: thanks. assigning to @sam to follow through and will update incident channel.

maria: thanks all :thumbsup: keep me posted.
